{{Top|leg}}
'''Anti-walker mines''' were a rare type of ground-based [[Mine/Legends|mine]]. They were set to detect areas of intense ground pressure and then trigger. Unfortunately, the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] in the mine were often triggered by large animals, non-[[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles like [[hovercraft]], and even heavy snow or rainfall.
